svg.title: Cost per litre of three ready-to-use cleaners
svg.desc: Horizontal bars of shelf cost per litre for Mr. Clean, Pine-Sol, and Lysol toilet bowl cleaner from the Costco East list posted 10 June 2026. No concentrate dilution was printed on that list.
svg.text: Price divided by labelled litres. Costco East, posted 10 Jun 2026. A concentrate pair is omitted: no dilution rate was on that list.
Lysol line: 4 times 946 mL = 3.784 L. $10.99 divided by 3.784 L = $2.90 per litre.
These are different jobs. A lower price per litre does not mean the product can replace the others.
For a concentrate, divide the bottle price by the litres the label says it makes, then compare to these bars.
Saving Optimizer, 26 Sep 2026. Green bar is the lowest of these three ready-to-use jugs.
